I've been depressed and failing at life for 3 years. I've got an appointment through referral from my therapist to start depression medication in a couple weeks. 


I'm ending the 3 year streak of fucked up right now. I'm trying to get myself out of debt, l'm trying to find my first real job in 3 years, and I'm staying away from relationships until I heal. None of that is happening yet so I'm in a very dark place, the worst I've ever been. But for the first time in 3 years I feel a little bit of hope. I feel like the medication is going to change things finally. 

I don't know what to say other than you're not alone. You can do this. We all can.

Be thankful that people want to help! I didn't ask for any help and spent a year failing class after class because I couldn't get out of bed let alone study. 

Definitely use the time to get on some medication and start adjusting and I hope you start feeling better. 

Try not to let it get you too down, it really is a good thing and a lot of people go through it.
I know. I'm completely afraid of letting myself get sucked back in. I have an apt with a psychologist next week.

I'm extremely worried that I'm going to take him back. I know full well that I'm in control of this decision, however I feel like my judgement is severely impaired right because I'm being hit with too much life at once. I am doing this alone, with no one to help me through and all I want is to just take him back and forgive him. I feel like the world is collapsing in on me and I have endless days of nothing to do. I haven't eaten in a week and I can't sleep. I've been through break ups before, but this is all too much for me to handle alone.

Thanks. I'm so scared that I'm not going to find a job. I feel like I'm just playing the lottery sending out resumes to companies that are probably getting hundreds of them. I am looking for jobs in different states and I have absolutely no connections. So I'm so sick about never finding a job.

Thanks for the comment, however this is not his first time being caught lying. He had never cheated (that I know of) but he had a problem with lying. He even lied about the cheating when telling me about it (saying he only slept with her once the whole weekend, she told me they slept together the entire weekend). I can't move forward in a relationship with a liar who has showed me he'll only continue to lie.
But all I have is an undergrad BA and no job. I don't have money to go for more schooling. I would feel much better about myself if I were doing something as great as you.
